[[Decade Axes "Rival Skies"]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[axe]] obtained from [[Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]] in [[Embark Beach]] during the [[Anniversary Celebration]] in exchange for 5 [[Proof of Legend|Proofs of Legend]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage|Slashing Dmg]]: 6-28 (Requires 9 [[Axe Mastery]])
:Deals 20% additional damage during [[Special event|Festival events]]. No effect in [[PvP]].
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30
:Crafted in tribute to an enduring legend.
:{{Gray|Hides [[off-hand]] items.}}

==Skin==
Uses the same [[skin]] as both the [[Fiery Blade Axe]] and [[Icy Blade Axe]] dual wielded.

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as the "+20% damage during Festival Events" mod does not exist outside the unique Decade weapons.

==Notes==
*This axe is unique in that it hides any equipped [[focus item]] or [[shield]] and replaces it with the appearance of a second axe.
**The second axe is also displayed when no off-hand item has been equipped.
**The second axe is never displayed in the inventory window.
**The second axe and its shadow remain visible when the [[camera]] is zoomed in to first-person mode.
*The inherent bonus damage during events is only active during certain events ([[Canthan New Year]], [[Anniversary Celebration]], [[Dragon Festival]], [[Wayfarer's Reverie]], [[Halloween]], and [[Wintersday]]).
{{anomaly|Unlike [[Decade Rod "All the World"]], [[Decade Rod "Antipode Alloy"]], [[Decade Rod "Undying Service"]], [[Decade Staff "Astral Pillar"]], [[Decade Staff "Underworld Pillar"]] and all non-Decade [[weapon]]s, this axe's appearance is not changed when the wielder is under the effects of a [[weapon spell]].}}

==Trivia==
*Introduced in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20150422|April 22, 2015 update]].
